step1.title: Welcome to Project ALEX, be ready to learn and teach!
step1.text: We start with a tour of our Lateral Menu, it centralizes information and shortcuts to system features

step2.title: User Area
step2.text: This is your area, you can access your plans and classes and your favorites list

step3.title: Navigating the system
step3.text: Here you can access the courses and projects created by the entire community

step4.title: Professor Area
step4.text: Here Professors manage their classes and projects

step5.title: Profile and Settings
step5.text: Here you can see your user profiles and your account settings

step6.title: End of the tour
step6.text: Now you are ready to use Project ALEX, enjoy!
